blocks.prompt: 10. Two cars start together in the same direction from the same place. The first goes with uniform speed of 20km/h. The second goes at a speed of 12km/h in the first hour and increase the speed by 1 km/h each succeeding hour. After how many hours will the second car overtake the first car if both cars go non-stop?
blocks.explanation:
Doosri gaari pehli ko tab pakarti hai jab dono ne barabar kul faasla tay kar liya ho. Pehli gaari har ghante 20 km chalti hai. Doosri pehle ghante 12 km, doosre 13 km, teesre 14 km: har ghante 1 km zyada, yani A.P. Is liye doosri gaari ka kul faasla A.P. ka jama hai.
Plan: \(t\) ghanton mein dono ke faasle likhenge, barabar rakhenge aur \(t\) nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: Gaari 1: har ghante 20 km. Gaari 2: 12, 13, 14, ... km har agle ghante.
Humein find karna hai: woh ghante \(t\) jab dono ke faasle barabar hon.
Tareeqa: Gaari 2 ka faasla \(S_t = \frac{t}{2}[2a_1 + (t - 1)d]\), \(a_1 = 12\), \(d = 1\).

Pehli gaari ka faasla
\[\text{Car 1}: 20t \text{ km}\]
Kyun: Yaksaan (uniform) raftaar 20 km/h, to \(t\) ghanton mein \(20t\) km.

Doosri gaari ka faasla
\[S_t = \dfrac{t}{2}[2(12) + (t - 1)(1)]\]
\[= \dfrac{t}{2}(t + 23)\]
Kyun: Har ghante ka faasla 12, 13, 14, ... A.P. hai (\(a_1 = 12\), \(d = 1\)), aur \(t\) ghanton ka kul faasla is ke \(t\) terms ka jama. Bracket mein \(24 + t - 1 = t + 23\).

Faasle barabar rakh kar hal karein
\[20t = \dfrac{t}{2}(t + 23)\]
\[40 = t + 23\]
\[t = 17\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 2 se multiply kiya to \(40t = t(t + 23)\). Phir \(t\) se divide kiya; yeh jaiz hai kyunke \(t = 0\) to shuru ka lamha hai jab dono saath khari theen. Baqi \(40 = t + 23\), yani \(t = 17\).
Dhyan dein: \(t\) ko cancel karne se pehle \(t = 0\) wala hal pehchan lein, aur samjhein ke woh overtake nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{Car 1}: 20 \times 17 = 340\]
\[\text{Car 2}: \dfrac{17}{2}(12 + 28) = 340 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 17th ghante mein doosri gaari \(12 + 16 = 28\) km chalti hai. \(\frac{t}{2}(\text{pehla} + \text{aakhri})\) se 340 km, aur pehli gaari bhi 340 km. Is ke baad doosri gaari tez hai, is liye aage nikal jaati hai.
